decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details of hard and soft landscaping, as submitted by Limbrick Architecture and Design received 18 May 2007 and shown on drawing numbers 978/PL114 - 122 and Ilman Young Landscape Specification dated 8 December 2006, received 18 May 2007, pursuant to condition nos.15 and 17 of planning permission 00946/B/P24, dated 19 April 2007, are satisfactory and approval is recommended without the addition of further conditions.
description: Following approval for the redevelopment and erection of a health and racquets club following a fire and the provision of a temporary plastic dome structure over three courts during winter season, details submitted pursuant to Condition 15 (Hard and Soft Landscaping) of permission 00946/B/P24 dated 19/04/07.
